library(tidyverse); library(WebPower)
output <- function(d){for (i in 1:nrow(d)){if (d$test[i]=='regression'){d$small[i]<-wp.regression(n=d$n[i],p1=1,f2=0.1^2,power=NULL,alpha=0.05)$power;d$medium[i]<-wp.regression(n=d$n[i],p1=1,f2=0.25^2,power=NULL,alpha=0.05)$power;d$large[i]<-wp.regression(n=d$n[i],p1=1,f2=0.4^2,power=NULL,alpha=0.05)$power;f2<-wp.regression(n=d$n[i],p1=1,f2=NULL,power=.80,alpha=0.05)$f2;d$p80[i]<-sqrt(f2)*2;f2<-wp.regression(n=d$n[i],p1=1,f2=NULL,power=.95,alpha=0.05)$f2;d$p95[i]<-sqrt(f2)*2}};d}
dMRIreg <- output(read.csv('/data/fMRInf_regulation.csv'))
dMRIbeh <- output(read.csv('/data/fMRInf_behaviour.csv'))
tMRIreg <- dMRIreg %>% filter(pilot=='N') %>% summarize(across(c(n,small,medium,large,p80,p95), mean))
tMRIbeh <- dMRIbeh %>% filter(pilot=='N') %>% summarize(across(c(n,small,medium,large,p80,p95), mean))
tMRIout <- rbind(tMRIreg, tMRIreg, tMRIbeh, tMRIbeh)
print(tMRIreg)
RS
